name: SN 2020nta field (Hubble)
blurb: SN 2020nta field, the site of a type Ia supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020nta-hubble
story: Hubble came here to follow SN 2020nta, a type Ia supernova in a distant galaxy. It was one of a set of these explosions tracked to refine how fast the universe is expanding.

claims.text: SN 2020nta is a type Ia supernova observed by Hubble program 15889
The program's supernovae, SN 2020nta among them, lie in distant galaxies of the Hubble flow
SN 2020nta is classified as a type Ia supernova (Ia-91bg)
The program used type Ia supernovae to measure the expansion rate of the universe (H0)
